newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet confirms TV talks with Mediaset.
newsitem.headline: Stet confirms TV talks with Mediaset.

text.p: Italian state-controlled telecoms holding Stet's managing director Tomaso Tommasi di Vignano confirmed the group was in talks with multi-media group Mediaset to set up an Italian digital platform for satellite television services.
Milan daily Corriere della Sera said on Tuesday that an accord on the project, mentioned several times recently by Mediaset senior management, was likely to be reached soon.

Tommasi gave no details on when agreement would be reached. "We haven't set ourselves a fixed timetable but we have set ourselves a goal of offering a digital satellite and cable service together with other TV operators present in the Italian market or possibly in other markets," he told reporters.
Stet has already an outline agreement in the sector with state broadcaster RAI.
